title: W021.5 CTO Directive 142 Defect & Remediation Ledger
governingAuthority: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.6 / Rule IV-001 Non-Self-Acceptance

timezoneAnomalyExplanation.finding: Apparent future timestamp in Directive 141 defect ledger (2026-10-22T23:45:00.000Z)
timezoneAnomalyExplanation.rootCause: Developer machine local timezone is IST (UTC+05:30). Wall-clock time was 23:45 IST, but was mistakenly written with a 'Z' (UTC) suffix instead of converting to UTC (18:15:00.000Z).
timezoneAnomalyExplanation.remediation: All generation scripts and reports now strictly utilize runtime dynamic new Date().toISOString() without manual timezone formatting.

defects.title: Exposed Staging Service-Role Credential Pending Administrative Rotation
defects.rootCause: Staging service-role credential was removed from source code but administrative key rotation and access-log disposition on fkpigozcqnmcvofuksar remain unconfirmed by authorized administrator.
remediationActions: Kept remote staging write execution disabled in all operational paths.
Truthfully recorded status as CONTAINMENT_PENDING_ADMIN_CONFIRMATION across all registers, ledgers, and manifests.
Production Supabase project (ehfafcnimmjusyvplbah) strictly air-gapped (0 queries, 0 mutations).
Requires authorized administrator to verify key rotation and review access logs for exposure interval.
defects.externalPrerequisite: Authorized Project Administrator confirmation of JWT secret rotation via Supabase dashboard on fkpigozcqnmcvofuksar and access-log audit.

defects.title: Symmetric HMAC Replaced with Asymmetric Public-Key Authorization Verifier
defects.rootCause: Directive 141 implementation used symmetric crypto.createHmac('sha256', trustAnchor) with HS256 instead of the asymmetric public-key signature verifier specified in the governance design.
remediationActions: Completely rebuilt scripts/lib/stagingAuthorization.mjs to use genuine asymmetric public-key signature verification.
Enforced strict algorithm allowlist restricted to Ed25519 and RS256; prohibited symmetric algorithms (HS256) and unsigned tokens.
Ensured production verifier operates strictly with public keys (crypto.createPublicKey) and contains zero private keys or signing methods.
Created isolated test helper tests/helpers/stagingAuthTestHelper.mjs for test key generation and token signing.
Implemented fail-closed trust anchor resolution (KSHETRA_CTO_PUBLIC_KEY, options.trustAnchor, governance/keys/cto_staging_auth_public.pem).
Authored 20-test battery in tests/staging-authorization-verifier.test.mjs proving that a public key holder cannot forge authorization tokens (20/20 PASS).

defects.title: Ephemeral In-Memory Replay Store Replaced with Concurrency-Safe Durable Replay Store
defects.rootCause: Directive 141 tracked nonces in process-local JavaScript Set objects, resetting on process restarts and failing cross-process replay protection.
remediationActions: Created scripts/lib/stagingReplayStore.mjs implementing durable, disk-backed atomic nonce reservation and revocation.
Enforced cross-process mutual exclusion via file locking (.lock) with stale-lock expiration detection and atomic temp-file renaming.
Store fails closed with REPLAY_STORE_UNAVAILABLE if lock or store file is unconfigured or unwritable.
Added adversarial multi-process test verifying nonce replay rejection across independent Node child processes.

defects.title: Process-Wide Network Denial Preload Harness and Credentialless Local Preparation
defects.rootCause: Directive 141 mock transport was in-process only; network requests could still escape if submodules or dependencies bypassed the injected transport.
remediationActions: Created process-wide network denial preload harness in tests/fixtures/network-denial-preload.cjs intercepting net.Socket, tls, http, https, dns, and fetch.
Configured scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs to execute Mode A (Local Preparation & Reconciliation) by default with ZERO credentials in the environment and ZERO network calls.
Authored 5/5 passing tests in tests/staging-transport-isolation.test.mjs including negative harness proof and full CLI process execution under process-wide network denial.

defects.title: Complete Mode B Staging Engine Implementation with Typed Results and Conflict Targets
defects.rootCause: Directive 141 lacked a concrete, typed implementation of Mode B staging execution across all 4 database-dependent criteria.
remediationActions: Fully implemented Mode B staging execution path in scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs for CRIT-C02-02, CRIT-D02-02, CRIT-E01-02, and CRIT-F02-03.
Each stage returns typed StageExecutionResult objects with targetTables, operations, rowsAffected, and durationMs.

Explicitly bound idempotent on_conflict targets: CRIT-C02-02 (id), CRIT-D02-02 (person_id, election_year, election_type, constituency_id), CRIT-E01-02 (composite_id), CRIT-F02-03 (election_id, constituency_id).
Tested 5/5 in tests/staging-execution-mode-b.test.mjs via mock transport (0 remote calls), validating all fail-closed gates and execution paths.

defects.title: CRIT-C02-02 Migration Name and Table Schema Reconciled to Actual Repository Artifacts
defects.rootCause: Reports and previous tests referenced an obsolete filename 065_w021_5_political_organizations_catalog.sql and did not validate against deployed schema table names.
remediationActions: Reconciled exact migration file: supabase/migrations/065_canonical_political_organization_registry.sql.

Reconciled exact catalog table names: public.political_organizations, public.organization_relationships, public.organization_multilingual_names, public.organization_symbols, public.organization_aliases, public.provenance_records.
Validated exact sum of 1,207 rows across 6 tables (107 orgs, 10 relationships, 27 multilingual, 19 symbols, 1043 aliases, 1 provenance) with 100% foreign key integrity.

defects.title: CRIT-D02-02 Natural Key Collision Resolution for All 36 Duplicate Candidacy Declarations
defects.rootCause: Candidacy deduplication previously verified count (36) without resolving candidate IDs back to parsed tuples or independently deriving natural keys.
remediationActions: Implemented candidate ID mapping resolving both retainedId and discardedId for all 36 duplicate declarations in reports/w021_5_b2_2d_36_candidacy_duplicates.json.
Proved both candidate IDs in each pair map to the identical natural key (person_id::election_year::election_type::constituency_id).
Verified 11,334 source tuples across 10 subchunk SQL files, exactly 36 duplicate collisions, and 11,298 unique authoritative candidacies.

defects.title: CRIT-E01-02 Mathematical Reconciliation of 4,142 Manifest Records vs 4,123 Statutory Assembly Seats
defects.rootCause: Unexplained discrepancy between 4,142 demographic manifest records and 4,123 statutory assembly seats.
remediationActions: Identified exact root cause: Delhi seed defines 221 entries (151 non-statutory records above Delhi's 70 seats) and Himachal Pradesh seed defines 70 entries (2 non-statutory entries above Himachal's 68 seats), totaling 153 extra non-statutory records. Additionally, 12 states have 134 missing statutory seats in the demographics seed.
Mathematically proved: 4,123 statutory seats - 134 missing + 153 extra non-statutory records = exactly 4,142 manifest records.
Classified authoritative statutory inventory (4,123 seats) as the governing boundary.
Implemented field-by-field integrity validation detecting missing, null, non-numeric, and out-of-range fields separately; preserved DQ-W021.5-B2.2E-001 (5 Mizoram seats).

defects.title: CRIT-F02-03 Elimination of Fabricated Zeroes and Preservation of Null Semantics
defects.rootCause: mapHistoricalCoverageToResultRow() converted missing winnerVotes and margin values to 0, violating data truth.
remediationActions: Eliminated zero-fabrication: preserved null for missing or unrecorded votes and margins.
Preserved genuine numeric zeroes only when explicitly established by source for uncontested seats (Arunachal Pradesh AC 4, 16, 31).
Enforced fail-closed rejection of negative or NaN votes/margins, missing candidate names, and placeholder parties/names ('Winner', 'OTH').
Preserved Jammu & Kashmir 2014 statutory boundary at exactly 87 seats; clearly tagged synthetic election IDs as test-only.

defects.title: Root Cause Analysis and Resolution of Directive 141 Timestamp Anomaly
defects.rootCause: Developer machine local timezone is IST (UTC+05:30). In Directive 141 defect ledger, the wall-clock time was 23:45 IST, but was formatted with 'Z' (UTC) by mistake (23:45:00.000Z instead of 18:15:00.000Z).
remediationActions: Documented exact root cause in defect ledger and implementation report.
Enforced runtime dynamic new Date().toISOString() across all scripts, eliminating manual timezone formatting.
